author: Yffe
content: Failing test at forge/tests/divergence_kernel_time_boundary.rs::admitted_time_fx_boundary_builds_kernel_rlib demonstrates divergence: forge build --target kernel conformance/effect_link_demo.th (fx time — on the kernel-target.md OQ-2 ADMIT list) exits 2 with a raw rustc E0433 (std::time::SystemTime in the emitted mod os under #![no_std]) instead of building a kernel rlib. reject_ambient_fx_for_kernel covers only read/write/net/term, so a time boundary survives with a non-empty reachable_boundary_targets set, falsifying the design's empty-target-set invariant (Architecture section). Fix is the generator's call: a no_std wrapper path, or a design amendment extending the reject to boundary-carrying admitted effects + a structured NAMED-effect refusal (REQ-3 shape).
